Mateo (Support): CS handoff — Solace trial activation stuck, ticket #45678. Customer reports embed ingest 403. Need CS + enablement comms. :warning:
Aisha (CS): Which customer tier and when did this start?
Mateo (Support): Trial, 14d, started 2026-02-28. Error snippet below. Eng looped in but no ETA on a fix.
Mateo (Support): ```
POST /v1/embeds 403 Forbidden
{"error":"tenant_not_authorized_for_embed"}
```
Evan (Enablement): Can you confirm if they tried alternative ingest paths? I can prepare a short workaround playbook if data policies allow. @Mateo please confirm tenant id and data class.
Mateo (Support): Tenant: solace-trial-22. Data: contains PII (names + emails), non-PHI. Customer asked for next steps this morning.
Jordan (CS Manager): If this isn't resolved in 48h renewal risk spikes. Recommend: immediate customer communication, trial extension, and an enablement walkthru. Aisha, can you draft that comm? @Riley FYI on renewal posture.
Riley (AE): Thanks — I'll pause renewal outreach for now. If CS offers a one-week extension, that should buy time.
Aisha (CS): Drafting now. Will offer 7-day extension, proposed subject: "Solace — Temporary access workaround & timeline". Need confirm on workaround from Enablement.
Mateo (Support): Eng suggested a temporary header bypass in staging: `X-Org-Bypass: true` but flagged as security risk.
Evan (Enablement): Don't surface bypass to customer. Safer option: presigned ingest link + scoped API key with limited scope + audit log. I'll assemble step-by-step and a short screen-share checklist.
Mateo (Support): Ops-bot posted deployment alert to infra: `deploy-guard: rate-limit` at 10:12 UTC.
Jordan (CS Manager): Action items: 1) Aisha send comm in 60m (include extension + honest ETA) 2) Evan share workaround playbook in 2h 3) Riley update AE doc and hold renewal 4) Mateo escalate to eng P0 if no ETA in 6h.
Aisha (CS): Will send a draft in ~30m for review.
Evan (Enablement): Will upload playbook to the shared drive and ping here.
Riley (AE): I'll prep the renewals note and cc Jordan.
Mateo (Support): I'll keep status updates here and tag infra if we need immediate escalation.
Jordan (CS Manager): Please react with :thumbsup: when each action is complete. Prioritize transparency — customer is very time-sensitive.
Aisha (CS): :thumbsup:
Evan (Enablement): :thumbsup:
